_meta.title: CBO, The Distribution of Household Income, 2022 — supplemental data
_meta.closes: Blockers B1 and B4 — COMPLETELY. Not just 2022: every table runs 1979-2022.
_meta.units: Table 3/4 in 2022 dollars (constant). Tables 9/10/12 in percent. Table 1 counts.

definitions.income_before_transfers_and_taxes: market income plus social insurance benefits
definitions.income_groups: households ranked by income before transfers and taxes, adjusted for household size; quintiles contain equal numbers of PEOPLE, not households
definitions.federal_taxes: individual income taxes, payroll taxes, corporate income taxes, and excise taxes
definitions.average_federal_tax_rate: total federal taxes for a given income group divided by that group's income before transfers and taxes
definitions.deflator: price index for personal consumption expenditures

_meta.caveat: Numbers may not add to totals because of rounding; dollar amounts are rounded. All years are calendar years.

income_group_minimums.note: The dollar threshold to enter each income group, BY HOUSEHOLD SIZE. CBO adjusts for household size, so there is no single threshold.

columns: Adjusted income before transfers and taxes
Adjusted income after transfers and taxes
median_household_income.note: 'Adjusted' columns are size-adjusted (divided by the square root of household size), which is why they are far lower than the unadjusted figures. Do not mix the two.
